snippet.title: Mega Man: Dual Override - Robot Master Design Contest Announcement
snippet.description:
The Robot Master Design Contest for Mega Man: Dual Override is now open!
We're looking for designs of a Robot Master who has a right arm with immense suction powers!
Will your design be the one to face Mega Man in the game!?
Draw, Mega Man fans, for everlasting peace!

Official website:
https://www.capcom-games.com/megaman/do/

Robot Master Design Contest
https://www.capcom-games.com/megaman/do/en-us/contest/

#MegaManDO #DesignARobotMaster #MegaMan
